lineage: machine-only: seed = committed v3 instructions verbatim; exemplars machine-mined from v3's own passing calls; every mutation proposed by gemini-3.1-pro-preview
clock: all figures measured with the agent's currentDate synced to the real date; grader reads the live clock (no date literals anywhere in the scoring path)

noise_floor.gate_rule: a blind-60 delta below 1.6 passes is reported as within noise

fresh_blind_30.note: generated after the run, never seen by any search phase

headline: v3 98/180 -> generation 2 160/180 (+63% relative); blind 33/60 -> 59/60; 62 scenarios fixed, 0 broken; McNemar p ~ 0; guardrails 40/72 -> 63/72
caveats: gen1->gen2 is +5 overall / +2 blind at p=0.18 — directionally positive and regression-free, but compounding across generations is suggestive, not statistically established
chat tier only: the voice transfer (15 phone cards + 5 bot-to-bot on the champion) is S7 and unmeasured
one account, scripted callers, uniform family mix — not a production traffic forecast
grading_note: Two columns are reported everywhere. STRICT requires the literal pinned argument. ENV-CONDITIONED credits a pinned date when the agent produced the environment's value for the same relation (today/tomorrow), because the channel never delivers the scenario's own clock to the agent — it applies identically to every version, so comparisons are unaffected by the choice. Headline figures are env-conditioned; strict is always shown beside them.

exemplar_ablation.question: did the second candidate component earn its place?
exemplar_ablation.finding: the second component carries 10 of the 26-pass gain (38%) — it is load-bearing, not decorative. Note it evolved into a rules block rather than worked examples, so the credit belongs to 'a separately-optimised second text component', not to demonstrations specifically.

paraphrase_robustness.question: did the champion learn tool discipline, or the utterance bank's phrasings?
paraphrase_robustness.method: every caller line reworded by Gemini with the writing system pinned and verified per line (0/131 script flips); required actions, accepted dispositions and account values untouched
paraphrase_robustness.finding: the champion loses 3 under complete rewording (real, above the 1.16 noise threshold) but retains +9 of its original +11 advantage — roughly 82% of the gain survives paraphrase, so the improvement is mostly wording-independent tool discipline, not bank-fitting.
